description: Figure 6(b) illustrates how the AUC metric varies with the hyperparameter \(N\) for five methods, shown as five colored line series with markers. The x-axis is labeled \(N\) on a linear scale, spanning from 1 to 20 with regularly spaced tick labels at 1, 5, 10, 15, and 20. The y-axis is labeled AUC (%) on a linear scale, ranging from 70 to 100 with tick labels at 70, 80, 90, and 100. The SMD series is drawn in orange with square markers and a solid line, rising from roughly the low-80s at \(N=1\) to a peak near the mid-90s around \(N=10\), then declining to the high-80s by \(N=20\). The PSM series is blue with circular markers and a solid line, starting near the mid-90s at \(N=1\), increasing slightly to just under 100 around \(N=10\), and then decreasing to the mid-90s by \(N=20\). The SWaT series is green with plus-shaped markers and a solid line, beginning around the high-80s at \(N=1\), increasing to the mid-90s near \(N=10\), and then tapering to the low-90s by \(N=20\). The SMAP series is magenta with star markers and a solid line, starting around 70 at \(N=1\), increasing sharply to the mid-90s near \(N=10\), and then dropping to the mid-to-high 70s by \(N=20\). The MSI series is yellow with triangle markers and a solid line, beginning around the low-80s at \(N=1\), rising to the low-90s near \(N=10\), and then decreasing to the mid-80s by \(N=20\).
